fn partial_unique_index(name: impl Into<String>, keys: Document, filter: Document) -> IndexModel {
    IndexModel::builder()
        .keys(keys)
        .options(
            IndexOptions::builder()
                .name(name.into())
                .unique(true)
                .partial_filter_expression(filter)
                .build(),
        )
        .build()
}
